##################
## Requirements ##
###########################################################################
# * Log sensor data and perform realtime calculations to estimate vehicle #
#   position and state throughout flight (i.e. determine apogee)          #
# * Store and transmit data compliant with the PDTP format                #
# * Receive commands in PDTP format, decode, and execute                  #
# * Schedule incoming commands based on PDTP message type (i.e. abort     #
#   executes immediately)                                                 #
# * Electrically activate parachute deployment charges                    #
# * Calculate flight trajectory corrections and apply vector controls     #
#   (i.e. RCS or TVC)                                                     #
# * Send PDTP data packets over RF and/or WiFi/BLE (I2C as needed)        #
###########################################################################

Features to implement/support:
- THE RF MODULE IS ON THE OUTSIDE
- PDTP (this needs to be FULLY functional)
  - Multiple message types/formats
  - Need to implement FSB
  - Need to test and verify CRC checking
  - Need to write and test receiving code (ground station)
  - Need to write test data to simulate various scenarios
    (i.e. We will need to simulate abort handling at various stages)    
- BLE/WiFi in addition to RF
- Pyro charge control (use of ~relay(s)~ MOSFETs)
- Pyro channel continuity checking (not sure how to do that yet)
- Battery level reporting
- Clearly define launch states and create a state flow map (determine state transition routes)
- Improve modularity through flight configuration variables (i.e. telem flag )
- Update all libraries and dependencies

[NOTES]
---------------------------------
REMEMBER: 1 byte = 8 bits
SOLUTION = Everything gets 2 bytes = that gives us 24 bytes for the input data
(12 parameters)

6 bytes go to "data frame" parameters (i.e. FS Byte, Destination Address, etc.)
24 bytes go to "payload"
---
32 bytes (max I2C transmission size)
---
frick: floats are 4 bytes so we can't just assign things 2 bytes...
Okay, payload will be split into 2 packetSize
---
update again: we're switching EVERYTHING to ints! signed ints
only take up 2 bytes, so that would fall in line with everything
we listed above!THE RF MODULE IS ON THE OUTSIDE

also, we wouldn't have to split the payload packet (which is
ideal to me)
--- 
well, almost... 13x2 is actually NOT 24, nor is 26 + 6 = 32... we have
some rearranging to do here...

payload = 26 bytes (2 bytes per parameter)
FSB = 1 byte
dest addr = 1 byte
src addr = 1 byte
seq numb = 2 byte
fcsn = 1 byte

*this* is possibly the only way that we can make this work... this also
would require the addresses to only be 1 byte, which is actually okay
because 1 byte = 8 bits, which can make any number up to 255, and 
the addresses are 115 and 130 (for some fucking reason), so that's
actually fine.

whew!
---
